name: va-corporate-tax-and-bpol
description: Compute Virginia corporate income tax (Form 500) for tax year 2026 and the local BPOL gross receipts license tax. Covers the 6% rate on Virginia taxable income, the December 31, 2025 conformity date, the standard double-weighted sales apportionment formula and the single sales factor industries, separate, consolidated or combined filing, Form 500 due dates (15th day of the 4th month) with the automatic 7-month extension, Form 500ES estimated tax when tax is expected to exceed $1,000, penalties, the pass-through entity return (Form 502), 5% nonresident owner withholding, the 5.75% elective PTET (Form 502PTET), and BPOL rate caps per $100 of gross receipts ($0.16 contractors, $0.20 retail, $0.58 financial, real estate and professional, $0.36 repair, personal and business services, $0.05 per $100 of purchases for wholesalers) with the $100,000 / $50,000 thresholds and the March 1 license date.
